title: nb: conclusions/leads never get proposed; results pile up unconcluded

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text:
## Evidence (bioemu-kinetics, 2026-11-09)
- 7 conclusions, all 2026-10-30 to 11-02, each written after the user explicitly asked ("write up some conclusions", "draw that conclusion"). 0 leads ever.
- Since 11-03: 31 results, 0 conclusions. 13 of 51 results back any conclusion.
- All 33 hypotheses are open, though 10 results state the frozen-rule verdict in the summary ("Frozen rule: refuted ...").
- 30 of 31 frozen experiments/explorations have results but none was set to done, so the prime "In flight" section is mostly finished work.
- Transcripts: after a result the agent gives a labelled "My read" in chat (~12+), offered to record a conclusion 0 times, declined once ("Not recorded ... stays mine until you want it recorded"), and steered to the next experiment ~6-8 times. The user always replied with the next action.
- Cause: SKILL.md "Record no conclusions or leads ... unless the user asks" and "Interpreting (only when asked)". Pending + the gated confirm already gives the user the veto, so this second guard is redundant. No prime section or lint rule surfaces unconcluded results.
- Side: prime runs lint without the provenance checks, so it reported 1 warning while nb lint reports 12 (missing docs/figures artifacts).
